dogs.name: Niik
dogs.desc: Niik enjoys the sunshine in Sweden
dogs.story: Niik was first rescued by the organization from a dog meat trader, then spotted by his adopter on Red Note. With help from volunteers, Niik was brought to Germany, and from there his mom picked him up and took him to Sweden.

dogs.name: LiXia
dogs.desc: Meet Lìxià (立夏)—a name that means "the Beginning of Summer."
dogs.story:
Meet Lìxià (立夏) 🌱—a name that means "the Beginning of Summer." In the Chinese calendar, Lìxià marks the gentle turning point when spring gives way to warmer days, when everything begins to grow lush and full of life. It's a name full of hope and new beginnings, perfect for a dog stepping into a fresh chapter of their own.
Lìxià is wonderfully affectionate with people, though a little shy around the elderly. They're tidy by nature and prefer to do their business outdoors. 
Like the season they're named for, Lìxià has weathered their share of storms before reaching brighter days ☀️. They were rescued and treated for rectal prolapse, a skin condition, and a grade 2 patellar luxation. Happily, the prolapse and skin condition have both healed completely. The luxation isn't severe enough to need surgery for now, so it simply needs gentle, preventive care, which means staying on joint medication to keep them comfortable and moving well. With a little ongoing love and attention, this sweet soul is ready to blossom into their very own summer 🐾.
